title: Northbeam TechWorks Write-Off Authority: Recognised Grounds and Their Order
content:
A charge on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is written off only on a ground the retailer recognises: a protection plan authorising the work, the manufacturer's warranty covering it, a membership benefit, an error the retailer made, a term of a business contract, or an express goodwill decision.

## 1. Naming the ground, and which ground is named

A write-off names its ground, and the strongest ground is recorded where more than one would serve: plan cover before warranty, warranty before membership, and goodwill last of all.

| Grounds that would serve | Ground recorded |
| --- | --- |
| Plan cover and the manufacturer's warranty | plan cover |
| The manufacturer's warranty and a membership benefit | the manufacturer's warranty |
| A membership benefit and goodwill | the membership benefit |
| Goodwill alone | goodwill |

## 2. The size of a write-off

The clause that a write-off never exceeds the charge outstanding on the line it is granted against is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for how far a relief may run. A charge already settled is refunded rather than written off; that limb stands.

## 3. Goodwill

Goodwill is granted for the inconvenience the retailer caused rather than for the price of the work, and the same charge is not written off twice on different grounds.

## 4. A write-off granted in error

A write-off granted in error is reversed by billing the charge afresh with the same line reference, so the history stays on file.

## Points of judgement

**A charge the customer has already paid.** Clause 2 leaves the refund limb standing: a settled charge is refunded, not written off.

**A goodwill gesture on a charge already relieved on the plan's cover.** Clause 3 bars writing the same charge off twice on different grounds, and clause 1 would in any case record plan cover as the stronger of the two.

**An unrecognised ground.** The six grounds of the opening clause are the grounds the retailer recognises; a write-off resting on none of them is not a write-off this authority permits.

The per-service flags this authority reads — whether labour is covered without charge on manufacturer warranty work, whether it is covered where a protection plan authorises the work, whether the Circle tier's repair labour discount is applied to chargeable labour and whether rework inside the window is free — are carried in the cover applicability and quality schedules for the six TechWorks services.

superseded_clauses: A write-off never exceeds the charge outstanding on the line it is granted against
